title: Micro1 Surpasses $1B ARR on AI Training Data Demand
summary:
Revenue at the AI training data startup grew from approximately $500 million in August to $700 million just a few weeks ago before accelerating further. Micro1 has now surpassed $1 billion in annual recurring revenue (ARR), driven by its Data Partnerships program and sales of expert human data to AI labs. These laboratories are reportedly spending whatever it takes to secure the high-quality datasets required to improve model performance.

The company also closed a Series B funding round earlier this summer at a $4 billion valuation. The rapid climb in revenue indicates that high-quality training data has emerged as a gigantic market, as enterprises and laboratories prioritize specialized human-curated inputs for AI development.
